transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, well, what brings me in is that I'm just... really exhausted. And it's in a way that sleep doesn't seem to fix. Just getting through a normal workday and then coming home for dinner, it all just feels a lot heavier than it should right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah, I suppose I have. Most days lately, I just wake up with this... heavy, gray feeling. It's like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even really starts.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I definitely have. Um, normally I really love painting, or just wandering through museum exhibits. But recently... I just leave my supplies sitting there untouched. And the museums, I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I'd say it's been about a month. Um, it's actually a fairly recent swing. Before this, I was feeling unusually energized and driven, getting a lot done. But then it just shifted into this... persistently low feeling, and that's been going on for the last month or so.
During that energized period, did you need less sleep than usual without feeling tired?

Yeah, actually. Um, during that stretch I was sleeping maybe four hours a night. But I didn't feel tired at all. I'd just get up feeling completely ready to go—sending out work emails, sketching out event ideas, or even just reorganizing the kitchen.
How long did that unusually energized period last?

I'm actually not sure. Um, I didn't really keep track of the days while it was happening. It was just... a stretch of time where I was getting a lot done, and I didn't think to measure it. So I couldn't give you an exact timeframe.
During that energized period, did you feel unusually upbeat or unusually irritable compared with your usual self?

Well, it was a bit of both, actually. Earlier in the month, I just had this really charged, upbeat mood. Like, I felt absolutely brilliant one minute, just full of great ideas for work and everything. But then... if my husband questioned my plans or got in my way, I'd get irritated really fast. So it was this mix of feeling on top of the world, but also having a pretty short fuse.
About how many consecutive days did that unusually energized period last?

Like I said a minute ago, I really don't know exactly how many days it was. I wasn't keeping a calendar of it or anything. It was just a stretch of days where I felt like that, but I couldn't give you a specific number.
Did that energized period cause major problems in your work, relationships, or daily functioning?

Not major problems, no. I mean, I'm still showing up for work and handling things around the house. But... I guess I've just been a bit slower making decisions at work. And with my family, I've been a little less reliable with our plans. I've also kind of pulled back from my art projects, which is usually how I stay connected with people. So it's not falling apart, but things are definitely a bit off.
During that energized period, did your thoughts feel unusually fast or seem to jump rapidly from one idea to another?

Yeah, they did. It kind of felt like... well, like my mind had too many tabs open at once. I'd have ideas for work, and then things for the cultural group, and our household schedule—it was all just racing through my head together at the same time.
Did that energized period last at least four days in a row?

I'm really not sure. It might have been? But... like I said earlier, I just wasn't keeping track of it like that. It was definitely a few days in a row, but I couldn't tell you for certain if it hit four days or not.
Has there ever been a distinct period when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep that lasted at least four consecutive days?

I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I felt more energetic than usual, but nothing that lasted four days straight where I didn't need sleep. It's usually just a day or two of feeling a bit more driven, and then I go back to normal. So, no, not four days in a row.
How has your sleep been during this past month?

It hasn't been great, honestly. Even when I make sure to get to bed at a reasonable hour now, I end up waking up really early, usually around four or five in the morning. My mind just immediately starts going over work stuff, or thinking about my marriage, and once that happens, I'm just done sleeping. I can't fall back asleep after that.
Have you had any thoughts of killing yourself or not wanting to be alive?
No, no. I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, things have been stressful and I've been feeling pretty down, but I don't want to die. I haven't thought about hurting myself or anything.
During this past month, have you had trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Yeah, actually, I have. It's been pretty frustrating, especially at work. Like, I'll have a really simple staffing email open on my screen, and I'll just sit there and reread it over and over. I just... I can't seem to decide what to say or figure out which option makes sense. It's like my brain just stalls out on basic decisions.
